backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, role-based access control, Stripe checkout sessions, and data plan records with session ownership tracking.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping product requirements to modified frontend files and related components with high-confidence links.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file across components, hooks, styles, and configuration.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS layer defining color tokens, dark mode variables, and shared base styles for the app.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file bootstrapping the React app with a root container and module script entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component providing query client setup and simple pathname-based routing for payment success and failure pages.
frontend/src/components/DataPlansSection: UI section listing data plans with network tabs, plan cards, Stripe checkout actions, and bank transfer dialog integration with selected plan context.
frontend/src/components/IBNFooter.tsx: Footer component with brand info, quick links, contact details, social icons, and WhatsApp support links.
frontend/src/components/IBNHeader.tsx: Header component showing logo, contact button, and admin setup menus with dialogs for Stripe and bank transfer configuration.
frontend/src/components/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page assembling hero section, feature highlights, data plans, how-it-works, testimonials, FAQ, and CTAs.
frontend/src/components/LandingPageSecti: FAQ section rendering a list of common questions using an accordion UI.
Section displaying three-step process cards explaining how to purchase and receive data plans.
Testimonials section showing customer reviews with avatars, ratings, and feedback cards.
frontend/src/components/payments/BankTra: Admin form for configuring and saving bank transfer payment details with validation and success handling.
Displays bank transfer details, order summary, and copy-to-clipboard actions, or shows an unavailable notice if bank details are missing.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Shows a payment cancellation message with options to retry or contact support via WhatsApp.
Verifies Stripe session status and shows success, failure, or loading states with transaction details when applicable.
frontend/src/components/payments/PayNowB: Triggers Stripe checkout session creation, handles login via Internet Identity, and manages loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Provides a form for admins to configure Stripe secret keys and allowed countries, with validation and success feedback.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppCTA.tsx: Reusable WhatsApp CTA button that links to a prefilled WhatsApp chat URL.
frontend/src/data/mobileNetworkPlans.ts: Defines mobile network plan types and exports a catalog of data plans for MTN, GLO, Airtel, and 9Mobile.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor using the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, managing login, stored identities, and status states.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for Stripe setup, checkout sessions, bank details, and admin checks using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and theme variables defining light and dark color palettes and typography rules.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Generates WhatsApp URLs for general messages, data plan orders, and bank transfer confirmations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the app root, wrapping it in React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters across navigation using sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, radii, fonts, shadows, and enabling typography and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Holds metadata about the IBN project including versioning, goals, architectural notes, and a list of implemented features. Primarily defines the app’s branding, UI requirements, WhatsApp contact, payment additions, and design elements.
